description: Defines structures, constants, and inline functions for managing netlink sockets, including socket creation, configuration, and group membership management.

classes.name: nl_sock
classes.description: Represents a netlink socket with local and peer addresses, file descriptor, protocol, sequence counters, flags, and callback handler.

methods.name: nl_socket_use_seq
methods.description: Returns the next available sequence number and increments the counter.

methods.name: nl_socket_disable_auto_ack
methods.description: Disables automatic ACK requests for the socket.

methods.name: nl_socket_enable_auto_ack
methods.description: Enables automatic ACK requests for the socket.

methods.name: nl_socket_get_local_port
methods.description: Retrieves the local port (nl_pid) of the socket.

methods.name: nl_socket_get_peer_port
methods.description: Retrieves the peer port (nl_pid) of the socket.

methods.name: nl_socket_set_peer_port
methods.description: Sets the peer port (nl_pid) of the socket.

methods.name: nl_socket_get_fd
methods.description: Retrieves the file descriptor associated with the socket.

methods.name: nl_socket_enable_msg_peek
methods.description: Enables MSG_PEEK flag for reading from the socket.

methods.name: nl_socket_disable_msg_peek
methods.description: Disables MSG_PEEK flag for reading from the socket.

methods.name: nl_socket_get_peer_groups
methods.description: Retrieves the group membership bits of the peer.

methods.name: nl_socket_set_peer_groups
methods.description: Sets the group membership bits of the peer.

methods.name: nl_socket_get_cb
methods.description: Retrieves the callback handler associated with the socket.

methods.name: nl_socket_set_cb
methods.description: Sets the callback handler for the socket.

methods.name: nl_socket_modify_cb
methods.description: Modifies the callback handler for a specific callback type and kind.

methods.name: nl_socket_add_membership
methods.description: Adds the socket to a multicast group.

methods.name: nl_socket_drop_membership
methods.description: Removes the socket from a multicast group.
